CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red cell set), its presentation as coordinate set, and an explicit origin/status entry are all present for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit coordinate sets identify content (red/blue cell sets) with attribute labels and explicit time namespaces.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata are provided separately from coordinate/content listings, distinguishing identification from source/status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how content is presented (grid orientation) and presents explicit organized coordinate patterns for contents.
